questions.text:
निम्नलिखित कथनों का ध्यानपूर्वक अध्ययन कीजिए :
कथन 1 : सरकार किसी अर्थव्यवस्था में प्रचलित अपस्फीतिकारी अंतराल को नियंत्रित करने के लिए, रेपो दर में कमी कर सकती है।
कथन 2 : सरकार खुले बाज़ार में सरकारी प्रतिभूतियों (G-Sec) की बिक्री द्वारा, अपस्फीतिकारी अंतराल में कमी कर सकती है।
दिए गए कथनों के आलोक में, निम्नलिखित में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
questions.text_english:
Read the following statements carefully:
Statement 1: The government may reduce the repo rate, to control deflationary gap prevailing in the economy.
Statement 2: The government may reduce the deflationary gap, by selling off government securities (G-Sec) in the open market.
In the light of the given statements, choose the correct option from the following:

options.A: कथन 1 सत्य है और कथन 2 असत्य है।
options.B: कथन 1 असत्य है और कथन 2 सत्य है।

options_english.A: Statement 1 is true and Statement 2 is false.
options_english.B: Statement 1 is false and Statement 2 is true.

questions.solution: Statement 1 is true because reducing the repo rate lowers the cost of borrowing, encouraging investment and consumption to bridge a deflationary gap. Statement 2 is false because selling government securities reduces money supply in the economy, which further exacerbates the deflationary gap instead of reducing it.

questions.text: साधन लागत पर सकल मूल्य वृद्धि (GVA_FC) के मूल्य को प्राप्त करने के लिए, बाज़ार कीमत पर सकल मूल्य वृद्धि (GVA_MP) में/में से _______ को _______ जाना चाहिए। (रिक्त स्थानों की पूर्ति के लिए सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए)
questions.text_english: To arrive at the value of Gross Value Added at Factor Cost (GVA_FC), _______ must be _______ to/from Gross Value Added at Market Price (GVA_MP). (Choose the correct option to fill in the blanks)
questions.solution: The formula to derive GVA at Factor Cost from GVA at Market Price is: GVA_FC = GVA_MP - Net Indirect Taxes. Therefore, Net Indirect Taxes must be subtracted.

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित कथनों का ध्यानपूर्वक अध्ययन कीजिए :
कथन 1 : सार्वजनिक वस्तुएँ, वे वस्तुएँ होती हैं, जिनके लिए राष्ट्र की समस्त इकाइयों द्वारा भुगतान किया जाता है।
कथन 2 : निजी वस्तुएँ, वे वस्तुएँ होती हैं, जो किसी राष्ट्र की सरकार द्वारा उपदानित (subsidised) दरों पर उपलब्ध कराई जाती हैं।
दिए गए कथनों के आलोक में, निम्नलिखित में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
questions.text_english:
Read the following statements carefully:
Statement 1: Public goods are those goods for which the payments are made by all the entities in the country.
Statement 2: Private goods are those goods which are provided by the government of a country at subsidised rates.
In the light of the given statements, choose the correct option from the following:

options.A: कथन 1 सत्य है और कथन 2 असत्य है।
options.B: कथन 1 असत्य है और कथन 2 सत्य है।

options_english.A: Statement 1 is true and Statement 2 is false.
options_english.B: Statement 1 is false and Statement 2 is true.

questions.solution: Both statements are false. Public goods are non-excludable and non-rivalrous, and their consumption is not contingent on individual payments. Private goods are typically produced by the private sector for profit, not necessarily provided by the government at subsidized rates.

questions.text: _______ विनिमय दर प्रणाली के अंतर्गत, केन्द्रीय बैंक, विदेशी विनिमय (मुद्रा) दर को सीमाबद्ध रूप से नियंत्रित कर सकता है। (रिक्त स्थान की पूर्ति के लिए सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए)
questions.text_english: Under the _______ Exchange Rate System, the Central Bank can control the foreign exchange rate in a range bound manner. (Choose the correct option to fill in the blank)
questions.solution: In a Managed floating exchange rate system, the central bank intervenes in the foreign exchange market to keep the exchange rate within a desired range, combining features of both fixed and flexible systems.

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित कथनों अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) का अध्ययन कीजिए।
अभिकथन (A): प्रत्यक्ष कर व्यक्तियों/कम्पनियों की आय/लाभ पर आरोपित किए जाते हैं।
कारण (R) : प्रत्यक्ष करों के भुगतान का बोझ किसी अन्य इकाई पर स्थानांतरित नहीं किया जा सकता है।
questions.text_english:
Read the following statements - Assertion (A) and Reason (R).
Assertion (A): Direct taxes are imposed on income/profits of individuals/companies.
Reason (R): The burden of payment of direct taxes cannot be shifted to any other entity.

options.A: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं और कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या है।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं, लेकिन कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सत्य है, लेकिन कारण (R) असत्य है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) असत्य है, लेकिन कारण (R) सत्य है。

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: Both the assertion and the reason are true. The definition of a direct tax is precisely that the burden cannot be shifted to others, which explains why they are levied directly on the entity's income or profit.

questions.text: कीन्स के सिद्धांत के अंतर्गत, 'संदर्भ रेखा' (Reference Line) _______ कोण पर खींची गई मूल-बिंदु से गुज़रने वाली एक सीधी रेखा है। (रिक्त स्थान की पूर्ति के लिए सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए)
questions.text_english: Under the Keynesian theory, 'Reference Line' is a straight line passing through the origin drawn at an angle of _______ . (Choose the correct option to fill in the blank)
questions.solution: In Keynesian economics, the reference line (or income line) is drawn at a 45° angle from the origin because at every point on this line, the level of income equals the level of aggregate expenditure.

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित कथनों का ध्यानपूर्वक अध्ययन कीजिए :
कथन 1 : सीमांत उपभोग प्रवृत्ति (MPC) से तात्पर्य प्रति आय इकाई उपभोग से है।
कथन 2 : आय में वृद्धि के फलस्वरूप, उपभोग के स्तर में आनुपातिक वृद्धि सदैव आय के स्तर में वृद्धि से अधिक होती है।
दिए गए कथनों के आलोक में, निम्नलिखित में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
questions.text_english:
Read the following statements carefully:
Statement 1: Marginal Propensity to Consume (MPC) refers to the consumption per unit of income.
Statement 2: As the income increases, the proportionate increase in the level of consumption is always more than the increase in the level of income.
In the light of the given statements, choose the correct option from the following:

options.A: कथन 1 सत्य है और कथन 2 असत्य है।
options.B: कथन 1 असत्य है और कथन 2 सत्य है।

options_english.A: Statement 1 is true and Statement 2 is false.
options_english.B: Statement 1 is false and Statement 2 is true.

questions.solution: Both statements are incorrect. MPC is the ratio of change in consumption to change in income, not consumption per unit of income. Additionally, the change in consumption is always less than the change in income (MPC < 1), so the proportionate increase in consumption cannot be more than the increase in income.

questions.text: प्राथमिक घाटे के मापन का मुख्य उद्देश्य वर्तमान _______ पर ध्यान केन्द्रित करना है। (रिक्त स्थान की पूर्ति के लिए सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए)
questions.text_english: The main objective of measuring the primary deficit is to highlight present _______ . (Choose the correct option to fill in the blank)
questions.solution: Primary deficit is calculated as Fiscal Deficit minus Interest Payments. It represents the borrowing requirement of the government excluding interest on past debts, thereby highlighting the current fiscal imbalances.

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित कथनों का ध्यानपूर्वक अध्ययन कीजिए :
कथन 1 : जापान से भारी मशीनरी का आयात विदेशी मुद्रा की माँग का एक स्रोत है।
कथन 2 : वायनाड (केरल) में भूस्खलन के लिए अंतर्राष्ट्रीय पुनर्निर्माण व विकास बैंक (IBRD) द्वारा वित्तीय सहायता, विदेशी मुद्रा की आपूर्ति का एक स्रोत है।
दिए गए कथनों के आलोक में, निम्नलिखित में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
questions.text_english:
Read the following statements carefully:
Statement 1: Import of heavy machinery from Japan is a source of demand for foreign exchange.
Statement 2: Financial aid by International Bank for Reconstruction and Development (IBRD) for landslide in Wayanad (Kerala) is a source of supply of foreign exchange.
In the light of the given statements, choose the correct option from the following:

options.A: कथन 1 सत्य है और कथन 2 असत्य है।
options.B: कथन 1 असत्य है और कथन 2 सत्य है।

options_english.A: Statement 1 is true and Statement 2 is false.
options_english.B: Statement 1 is false and Statement 2 is true.

questions.solution: Both statements are true. Imports create a demand for foreign currency to pay for goods, and financial aid (inflow of foreign currency) from international organizations like the IBRD represents a source of supply of foreign exchange.
questions.topic: Sources of Demand and Supply of Foreign Exchange

questions.text: एक द्वि-क्षेत्रीय अर्थव्यवस्था में, समग्र माँग _______ व _______ के योगफल द्वारा निर्धारित की जा सकती है। (रिक्त स्थानों की पूर्ति के लिए सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए)
questions.text_english: In a two-sector economy, the Aggregate Demand can be determined by adding _______ and _______ . (Choose the correct option to fill in the blanks)
questions.solution: In a two-sector economy (consisting of households and firms), Aggregate Demand is the sum of household consumption expenditure (C) and investment expenditure (I).

questions.text:
(क) किसी देश में राष्ट्रीय आय के आकलन की व्यय विधि से संबंधित किन्हीं दो सावधानियों की व्याख्या कीजिए।
अथवा
(ख) निम्नलिखित काल्पनिक आँकड़ों के आधार पर :
(₹ करोड़ में)
वर्ष | नाममात्र GDP | नाममात्र GDP (आधार वर्ष की कीमतों से समायोजित)
2020-21 | 3,000 | 5,000
2022-23 | 4,000 | 6,000
2020 – 21 को आधार वर्ष मानते हुए, वर्ष 2022 - 23 में वास्तविक सकल घरेलू उत्पाद (GDP) में प्रतिशत परिवर्तन की गणना कीजिए।
questions.text_english:
(a) Explain any two precautions pertaining to the Expenditure Method of estimation of National Income in a country.
OR
(b) On the basis of the following hypothetical data :
(in crore)
Year | Nominal GDP | Nominal GDP (adjusted to base year prices)
2020-21 | 3,000 | 5,000
2022-23 | 4,000 | 6,000
Calculate the percentage change in Real Gross Domestic Product (GDP) in the year 2022 - 23 using 2020-21 as the base year.

key_points: Expenditure on second-hand goods is excluded to avoid double counting.
Expenditure on transfer payments like scholarships or pensions is excluded as they are not for the purchase of currently produced goods and services.
Real GDP calculation: Change = [(6000 - 5000) / 5000] * 100 = 20%.

questions.solution: (a) Two precautions for the expenditure method are: First, expenditure on second-hand goods is excluded because these were already counted in the year they were originally produced. Second, expenditure on transfer payments, such as scholarships or pensions, is excluded as these do not involve the production of new goods or services. (b) To calculate the percentage change in Real GDP: Initial Real GDP (2020-21) is 5,000 crore and Final Real GDP (2022-23) is 6,000 crore. The percentage change is calculated as: [(6000 - 5000) / 5000] * 100, which equals 20%.

questions.text: "आय की असमानताओं को कम करने के लिए कराधान एक प्रभावी उपकरण है।" वैध कारणों द्वारा दिए गए कथन का औचित्य सिद्ध कीजिए।
questions.text_english: "Taxation is an effective tool to reduce income inequalities." Justify the given statement with valid reasons.

key_points: Progressive taxation levies higher rates on higher income levels.
Redistribution of wealth occurs as tax revenue is used for social welfare programs.
Subsidies and public services benefit lower-income groups.

questions.solution: Taxation acts as an effective tool for reducing income inequality through the use of progressive tax rates, where individuals with higher incomes pay a larger percentage of their earnings as taxes. The revenue collected is then redistributed by the government through various social welfare schemes, subsidies, and free public services like health and education, which primarily benefit the lower-income sections of society, thereby narrowing the gap between the rich and the poor.

questions.text:
(क) भुगतान संतुलन खाते के अंतर्गत पूँजी खाते के किन्हीं दो घटकों की व्याख्या कीजिए।
अथवा
(ख) स्वायत्त लेनदेनों व समायोजन लेनदेनों में अंतर स्पष्ट कीजिए ।
questions.text_english:
(a) Elaborate any two components of the Capital Account under the Balance of Payments Account.
OR
(b) Distinguish between Autonomous transactions and Accommodating transactions.

key_points: Components: Foreign Direct Investment (FDI), External Commercial Borrowings.
Autonomous: Motivated by profit, independent of BoP status.
Accommodating: Motivated by the need to balance the BoP account.

questions.solution: (a) Two components of the Capital Account are: Foreign Direct Investment (FDI), which involves foreign entities investing directly in domestic assets, and External Commercial Borrowings, which are loans raised by domestic entities from foreign sources. (b) Autonomous transactions are those international economic transactions that take place due to some economic motive such as profit maximization and are independent of the country's BoP status. Accommodating transactions are undertaken by monetary authorities to cover the surplus or deficit in the balance of payments to restore equilibrium.

questions.text:
एक काल्पनिक अर्थव्यवस्था के लिए मान लीजिए कि :
(i) स्वायत्त उपभोग व्यय (c bar) = ₹ 250 करोड़
(ii) सीमांत बचत प्रवृत्ति (MPS) = 0.2
(iii) स्वायत्त निवेश (I_0) = ₹ 200 करोड़
उपर्युक्त सूचना के आधार पर सम-स्तर आय व संतुलन आय के स्तरों का अनुमान लगाइए ।
questions.text_english:
Assuming for a hypothetical economy:
(i) Autonomous Consumption Expenditure (c bar) = ₹ 250 crore
(ii) Marginal Propensity to Save (MPS) = 0.2
(iii) Autonomous Investments (I_0) = ₹ 200 crore
Estimate the Break-even level of Income and Equilibrium level of Income, on the basis of information given above.

key_points: Break-even: Y = C. Since C = 250 + 0.8Y, Y = 250 + 0.8Y => 0.2Y = 250 => Y = 1250 crore.
Equilibrium: Y = C + I. Y = 250 + 0.8Y + 200 => 0.2Y = 450 => Y = 2250 crore.

questions.solution: Given c_bar = 250, MPS = 0.2 (so MPC = 0.8), and I_0 = 200. Break-even level of income (Y) is where Y = C. C = 250 + 0.8Y. Therefore, Y = 250 + 0.8Y, which gives 0.2Y = 250, so Y = 1250 crore. Equilibrium level of income is where Y = C + I. Y = 250 + 0.8Y + 200, which gives 0.2Y = 450, so Y = 2250 crore.

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित गद्य का ध्यानपूर्वक अध्ययन कीजिए :
एक शोध संस्था द्वारा निर्गमित एक रिपोर्ट में कहा गया है कि अर्थव्यवस्था में समग्र माँग, विशेषकर निजी उपभोग खंड में, तीव्र गिरावट आई है। वृहद् आर्थिक चरों में यह कमी, आर्थिक गतिविधियों को प्रोत्साहित करने के लिए रणनीतिक कार्यवाहियों की तत्काल आवश्यकता को परिलक्षित करती है।
दिए गए गद्य तथा सामान्य ज्ञान के आधार पर, उन उपायों की व्याख्या कीजिए जिन्हें सरकार संकेतिक समस्या को ठीक करने के लिए उठा सकती है।
questions.text_english:
Read the following text carefully :
According to a report issued by a research organisation, there is a sharp decline in the overall demand in the economy, particularly in the private consumption segment. This dip in the macro economic variables, highlights the urgent need for strategic actions to stimulate economic activities.
On the basis of the given text and common understanding, explain the measure which the government may take to solve the indicated problem.

key_points: Increase government expenditure to boost demand.
Reduce taxes to increase disposable income.
Lower interest rates to stimulate investment and consumption.

questions.solution: To address the decline in aggregate demand and private consumption, the government can adopt expansionary fiscal policy measures. This includes increasing government expenditure on public infrastructure and welfare projects, which injects money into the economy. Additionally, the government can reduce direct taxes on individuals to increase their disposable income, thereby encouraging private consumption. Furthermore, the central bank can reduce interest rates to make borrowing cheaper, which incentivizes both consumption and investment spending, helping to stimulate economic activities.
questions.chapter: Government Budget / Determination of Income and Employment

questions.text:
(क) (i) मान लीजिए कि, एक काल्पनिक अर्थव्यवस्था में केवल तीन फर्मे X, Y व Z हैं। एक वर्ष के दौरान, अर्थव्यवस्था में निम्नलिखित लेनदेन किए गए हैं :
(I) फर्म X द्वारा फर्म Y को ₹20,000 तथा फर्म Z को ₹12,000 के मूल्य का माल बिक्री किया गया।
(II) फर्म Y द्वारा फर्म X को ₹11,000 तथा फर्म Z को ₹35,000 के मूल्य का माल बिक्री किया गया।
(III) फर्म Z द्वारा गृहस्थों को ₹57,000 के मूल्य का माल अंतिम उपभोग के लिए बिक्री किया गया।
दिए गए लेनदेन के आधार पर अर्थव्यवस्था में, बाज़ार मूल्य पर सकल घरेलू उत्पाद (GDP_MP) के मूल्य की गणना कीजिए।
(ii) दो नवीन द्रुतगामी मार्गों (Express Highways) के निर्माण का किसी अर्थव्यवस्था में सकल घरेलू उत्पाद (GDP) व कल्याण पर पड़ने वाले संभावित प्रभावों की विस्तृत व्याख्या कीजिए।
अथवा
(ख) (i) निम्नलिखित आँकड़ों के आधार पर, राष्ट्रीय आय (NNP_FC) के मूल्य का अनुमान लगाइए :
मदें (₹ करोड़ में): गृहस्थ उपभोग व्यय (800), सकल व्यापारिक स्थायी पूँजी निर्माण (150), सकल आवासीय निर्माण निवेश (120), सरकारी अंतिम उपभोग व्यय (270), आयात का निर्यात पर आधिक्य (20), मालसूची निवेश (50), सकल सार्वजनिक निवेश (130), शुद्ध अप्रत्यक्ष कर (20), विदेशों से प्राप्त शुद्ध कारक आय (-25), स्थायी पूँजी का उपभोग (40).
(ii) "सभी उत्पादक वस्तुएँ अनिवार्य रूप से पूँजीगत वस्तुएँ होती हैं।" उपयुक्त उदाहरण की सहायता से दिए गए कथन का समर्थन अथवा खंडन कीजिए।
questions.text_english:
(a) (i) Suppose there are only three firms in an imaginary economy, namely X, Y, and Z. During a year, the following transactions took place in the economy:
(I) Firm X sold goods worth ₹20,000 to Firm Y and ₹12,000 to Firm Z.
(II) Firm Y sold goods worth ₹11,000 to Firm X and ₹35,000 to Firm Z.
(III) Firm Z sold goods worth ₹57,000 to households for final consumption.
On the basis of the given transactions, calculate the value of Gross Domestic Product at Market Price (GDP_MP) in the economy.
(ii) Elaborate the likely impact of the construction of two new express highways on Gross Domestic Product (GDP) and welfare in an economy.
OR
(b) (i) On the basis of the following data, estimate the value of National Income (NNP_FC):
Items (₹ crore): Household Consumption Expenditure (800), Gross Business Fixed Capital Formation (150), Gross Residential Construction Investment (120), Government Final Consumption Expenditure (270), Excess of Imports over Exports (20), Inventory Investment (50), Gross Public Investment (130), Net Indirect Taxes (20), Net Factor Income from Abroad (-25), Consumption of Fixed Capital (40).
(ii) "All producer goods are essentially capital goods." Defend or refute the given statement with a suitable example.

sub_questions.solution: Construction of highways increases GDP by boosting construction activity and connectivity. Welfare increases due to faster transportation and reduced costs, though potential environmental costs should be considered.

Refute. All capital goods are producer goods, but not all producer goods are capital goods. Raw materials are producer goods but are single-use, whereas capital goods are durable assets like machines.

questions.solution: Calculations provided in the sub-questions cover the requirement. GDP is measured as the sum of value added. NNP_FC calculation requires deducting depreciation and net indirect taxes from GDP_MP and adding net factor income from abroad. The distinction between producer and capital goods centers on durability.

questions.text:
(क) उपयुक्त संख्यात्मक उदाहरण द्वारा साख सृजन प्रक्रिया को विस्तार से समझाइए।
(ख) निम्नलिखित गद्य का ध्यानपूर्वक अध्ययन कीजिए :
"मुद्रा का यह कार्य एक सामान्य मानक के सामने मूल्यांकन की जाने वाली विभिन्न मदों को उपलब्ध कराता है। यह मूल्यों की तुलना करने व वित्तीय रिकॉर्ड रखने की अनुमति देता है।"
(i) दिए गए गद्य के आधार पर, मुद्रा के संकेतिक कार्य की पहचान कीजिए।
(ii) मुद्रा के किन्हीं दो अन्य कार्यों को सूचीबद्ध कीजिए।
questions.text_english:
(a) Elaborate the process of Credit Creation using a suitable numerical example.
(b) Read the following text carefully:
"This function of money provides a common standard against which different items are evaluated. It allows comparison of prices and maintaining financial records."
(i) On the basis of the given text, identify the indicated function of money.
(ii) List any two other functions of money.

sub_questions.solution: Credit creation by banks is based on the fractional reserve system. If initial deposit is ₹ 1000 and LRR is 10%, the total money creation = Initial Deposit * (1 / LRR). Total money created = 1000 * 10 = ₹ 10,000. Banks lend out the remaining 90%, which becomes new deposits, creating a multiplier effect.
Measure of Value (or Unit of Account).
Medium of Exchange and Store of Value.

questions.solution: Credit creation is the process where banks expand the money supply through lending, restricted only by the Legal Reserve Ratio (LRR). Money functions as a unit of account to allow price comparisons and financial record-keeping.

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित कथनों का ध्यानपूर्वक अध्ययन कीजिए :
कथन 1 : भारतीय कृषि के व्यावसायीकरण के लिए ब्रिटिश नीतियाँ ज़िम्मेदार थीं।
कथन 2 : भारतीयों के व्यापक हितों के लिए, ब्रिटिश शासकों ने भारत की आधारिक संरचना के विकास पर ध्यान केन्द्रित किया था।
दिए गए कथनों के आलोक में, निम्नलिखित में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
questions.text_english:
Read the following statements carefully:
Statement 1: The British policies were accountable for commercialisation of Indian agriculture.
Statement 2: In the larger interest of Indians, the British rulers focused on the infrastructural growth of India.
In the light of the given statements, choose the correct option from the following:

options.A: कथन 1 सत्य है और कथन 2 असत्य है।
options.B: कथन 1 असत्य है और कथन 2 सत्य है।

options_english.A: Statement 1 is true and Statement 2 is false.
options_english.B: Statement 1 is false and Statement 2 is true.

questions.solution: Statement 1 is true because British policies forced farmers to switch to cash crops for export. Statement 2 is false because British infrastructural development (like railways) was primarily for their own colonial and commercial interests, not for the benefit of Indians.
questions.chapter: Indian Economy on the Eve of Independence
questions.topic: Agriculture and Infrastructure under British Rule

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित कथनों अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) का अध्ययन कीजिए।
अभिकथन (A) : मानव पूँजी में निवेश में विवेकपूर्ण निर्णय लेने के लिए सूचना महत्त्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाती है।
कारण (R) : लोग श्रम बाज़ार व अन्य क्षेत्रों जैसे शिक्षा तथा स्वास्थ्य के बारे में सूचना प्राप्त करने के लिए निवेश करते हैं।
questions.text_english:
Read the following statements - Assertion (A) and Reason (R).
Assertion (A): Information plays a crucial role in judicious decision-making about investing in human capital.
Reason (R): Individuals invest to acquire information about the labour market and other areas such as education and healthcare.

options.A: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं और कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या है।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं, लेकिन कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सत्य है, लेकिन कारण (R) असत्य है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) असत्य है, लेकिन कारण (R) सत्य है।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: Both the assertion and the reason are true, and the reason provides a correct explanation for why information is essential—investing in information helps individuals make better choices regarding their health and education, which directly impacts human capital formation.

questions.text: पहचान कीजिए कि, निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा 1947 के पश्चात् भारत व पाकिस्तान की नीतियों में समानता को इंगित नहीं करता है।
questions.text_english: Identify, which of the following does not indicate the similarities in the policies of India and Pakistan in the post 1947 period.
questions.solution: Dual pricing policy was not a common shared feature or policy similarity between India and Pakistan in the post-1947 era, whereas the others were prominent features of their economic development strategies.
questions.chapter: Comparative Development Experiences of India and its Neighbours
questions.topic: Economic Policies of India and Pakistan

questions.text: पहचान कीजिए कि, भारत की ग्रामीण बैंकिंग प्रणाली के बारे में निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा कथन असत्य है।
questions.text_english: Identify, which of the following statements is incorrect about the Rural Banking system in India.

options.A: स्वतंत्रता उपरांत अवधि में, भारत में एक सुचारु रूप से संरचित ग्रामीण बैंकिंग प्रणाली का निर्माण किया गया था।
options.B: भारत में ग्रामीण बैंकिंग प्रणाली में बहु-एजेंसी संस्थानों का एक समूह सम्मिलित है।
options.C: क्षेत्रीय ग्रामीण बैंक, सहकारी व भूमि विकास बैंक भारत में ग्रामीण बैंकिंग प्रणाली के कुछ महत्त्वपूर्ण घटक हैं।
options.D: भारत में ग्रामीण बैंकिंग प्रणाली भारतीय स्टेट बैंक के मार्गदर्शन, निर्देशन व पर्यवेक्षण के अंतर्गत कार्य करती है।

options_english.A: In the post-independence period, a well-structured Rural Banking system was formulated in India.
options_english.B: Rural Banking system in India consists of a set of multi-agency institutions.
options_english.C: Regional Rural Banks, Cooperative and Land Development Banks are few important components of Rural Banking system in India.
options_english.D: Rural Banking system in India works under the guidance, instruction and supervision of the State Bank of India.

questions.solution: Statement (D) is incorrect because the rural banking system in India is largely supervised by NABARD (National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development), not solely the State Bank of India.

questions.text: स्वतंत्रता उपरांत अवधि में, भारत के नीति निर्माताओं ने प्रथम _______ पंचवर्षीय योजनाओं के लिए 'आत्मनिर्भरता' पर बल दिया था। (रिक्त स्थान की पूर्ति के लिए सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए)
questions.text_english: In the post-independence era, the policy makers of India pushed for 'self-reliance' for the first _______ Five Year Plans. (Choose the correct option to fill in the blank)
questions.solution: India emphasized self-reliance as a major goal for the first seven Five Year Plans to reduce dependence on foreign aid and imports.

questions.text: किसी विशेष फसल के स्थान पर, फसलों की विविध किस्मों का उत्पादन _______ के विविधीकरण के रूप में जाना जाता है। (रिक्त स्थान की पूर्ति के लिए सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए)
questions.text_english: Production of diverse varieties of crops rather than one specialized crop is known as diversification of _______ . (Choose the correct option to fill in the blank)
questions.solution: Diversification of crops refers to the shift from single-crop farming to the cultivation of a variety of different crops to reduce risk and increase farm income.

questions.text: पहचान कीजिए कि, पर्यावरण के कार्यों के संदर्भ में निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा कथन असत्य है।
questions.text_english: Identify, which of the following statements is incorrect about the functions of environment.

options.D: जीवन की गुणवत्ता का हास करना

questions.solution: The functions of the environment are to provide resources, absorb waste, and sustain life. Deteriorating the quality of life is an outcome of environmental degradation, not a functional role of the environment.

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित कथनों का ध्यानपूर्वक अध्ययन कीजिए :
कथन 1 : भारतीय खाद्य निगम, बाज़ार तंत्र को सुधारने के उपाय के रूप में गेहूँ व चावल का बफर स्टॉक बनाए रखता है।
कथन 2 : न्यूनतम समर्थन मूल्य (MSP), सरकार द्वारा कृषकों के हितों की रक्षा के लिए निर्धारित किया जाता है।
दिए गए कथनों के आलोक में, निम्नलिखित में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
questions.text_english:
Read the following statements carefully:
Statement 1: The Food Corporation of India maintains buffer stocks of wheat and rice as a measure to improve market mechanism.
Statement 2: Minimum Support Price (MSP) is imposed by the government to safeguard the interest of farmers.
In the light of the given statements, choose the correct option from the following:

options.A: कथन 1 सत्य है और कथन 2 असत्य है।
options.B: कथन 1 असत्य है और कथन 2 सत्य है।

options_english.A: Statement 1 is true and Statement 2 is false.
options_english.B: Statement 1 is false and Statement 2 is true.

questions.solution: Both statements are true. Buffer stocks help stabilize the market mechanism by controlling supply, and MSP ensures farmers receive a guaranteed price for their produce, protecting them from market fluctuations.

questions.text: मान लीजिए कि, एक अर्थव्यवस्था बिना किसी उचित रोज़गार के अवसरों में वृद्धि के, वास्तविक सकल घरेलू उत्पाद (GDP) में वृद्धि की स्थिति का सामना कर रही है। आर्थिक भाषा में, ऐसी स्थिति को _______ वृद्धि कहा जाता है। (रिक्त स्थान की पूर्ति के लिए सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए)
questions.text_english: Suppose an economy is experiencing a situation of rise in Real Gross Domestic Product (GDP), without any corresponding rise in the employment opportunities. In economic parlance, such a situation is termed as _______ growth. (Choose the correct option to fill in the blank)
questions.solution: Growth in GDP without a corresponding increase in employment is known as jobless growth.
questions.chapter: Employment: Growth, Informalisation and Related Issues

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित कथनों अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) का अध्ययन कीजिए।
अभिकथन (A) : परमिट लाइसेंस राज के अत्यधिक विनियमन ने कुछ निजी फर्मों को प्रतिस्पर्धी बनने से रोका था।
कारण (R) : निजी क्षेत्र ने उत्पाद की गुणवत्ता व अन्तर्राष्ट्रीय प्रतिस्पर्धात्मकता में वृद्धि करने के बजाय लाइसेंस प्राप्ति में महत्त्वपूर्ण समय बर्बाद किया था।
questions.text_english:
Read the following statements Assertion (A) and Reason (R). Choose the correct alternative from the options given below :
Assertion (A): Excessive regulation of permit license raj prevented certain private firms from becoming more efficient.
Reason (R): Private sector wasted a significant time in obtaining licenses rather than enhancing product quality and international competitiveness.

options.A: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं और कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या है।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं, लेकिन कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सत्य है, लेकिन कारण (R) असत्य है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) असत्य है, लेकिन कारण (R) सत्य है。

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: Both the assertion and the reason are true. The Permit License Raj necessitated excessive bureaucratic hurdles, causing firms to focus on compliance and acquisition of licenses rather than improving quality or competitive efficiency.

questions.text: चीन द्वारा कृषि क्षेत्र में किए गए आर्थिक सुधारों की व्याख्या कीजिए।
questions.text_english: Elaborate the economic reforms in agriculture sector undertaken by China.

key_points: Commune system was replaced by the household responsibility system.
Farmers were allowed to sell surplus produce in the market after meeting state quotas.
Increased incentive to boost production.

questions.solution: China initiated agricultural reforms in 1978 by replacing the collective commune system with the Household Responsibility System. This reform allowed households to cultivate land on a contractual basis and retain surplus produce for sale in the market after fulfilling government quotas. This significant change provided individual farmers with the incentive to increase agricultural production, resulting in substantial growth in the sector.
questions.chapter: Comparative Development Experiences of India and its Neighbours

questions.text:
(क) "ब्रिटिश शासन के अंतर्गत, भारत को व्यवस्थित आर्थिक शोषण का सामना करना पड़ा, इसके साथ संसाधन व धन संपदा ब्रिटेन को हस्तांतरित किए गए थे।" वैध स्पष्टीकरण द्वारा पुष्टि कीजिए।
अथवा
(ख) 1991 के सुधारों में भारत सरकार द्वारा अपनाई गई नवरत्न नीति का मूल्यांकन कीजिए।
questions.text_english:
(a) "Under British rule, India underwent systematic economic exploitation, with its resources and wealth being transferred to Britain." Justify the given statement with valid explanation.
OR
(b) Appraise the Navratna policy adopted by the Government of India during the 1991 reforms.

key_points: Colonial rule turned India into a supplier of raw materials and a market for British goods.
Drain of wealth through taxation and trade policies.
Navratan policy empowered public sector units to become global players.

questions.solution: (a) The British colonial policy turned India into a raw material supplier for British industries and a captive market for finished British goods. Through discriminatory trade practices, high land taxes, and the systematic drain of wealth, resources were diverted to enrich Britain, leaving India economically underdeveloped. (b) The Navratan policy in 1991 aimed to empower selected public sector enterprises by providing them with greater operational and financial autonomy. This strategy was designed to help these units improve their efficiency and compete globally in an increasingly deregulated market.
questions.chapter: Indian Economy on the Eve of Independence / Economic Reforms since 1991

questions.text:
(क) (i) मानव पूँजी व भौतिक पूँजी में अंतर स्पष्ट कीजिए।
(ii) ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों में 'LPG' व 'गोबर गैस' का धारणीय विकास प्राप्त करने के लिए उपयोग की जाने वाली रणनीति के रूप में वर्णन कीजिए।
अथवा
(ख) (i) ग्रामीण भारत में सूक्ष्म-साख (micro-credit) कार्यक्रमों का आलोचनात्मक मूल्यांकन कीजिए।
(ii) धारणीय विकास के अर्थ का उल्लेख कीजिए।
questions.text_english:
(a) (i) Distinguish between human capital and physical capital.
(ii) Describe 'LPG' and 'Gobar Gas' as strategies used to achieve sustainable development in rural areas.
OR
(b) (i) Critically appraise the micro-credit programmes in rural India.
(ii) State the meaning of sustainable development.

key_points: Human: Knowledge/skill in people; Physical: Machines/factory.
LPG/Gobar Gas: Clean energy reducing deforestation and indoor pollution.
Micro-credit: Empowering rural poor vs. high interest/dependency risks.
Sustainable development: Meet present needs without compromising future generations.

questions.solution: (a) (i) Physical capital consists of tangible assets like machines and tools, while human capital consists of the intangible skills, knowledge, and health of the population. (ii) LPG and Gobar Gas provide clean, efficient fuel sources for rural households, reducing reliance on firewood and coal. This practice curbs deforestation and mitigates health issues caused by indoor air pollution. (b) (i) Micro-credit programs have been crucial in providing financial inclusion and self-employment opportunities to the rural poor. However, criticisms point towards the high interest rates charged by some informal lending groups and the risk of debt traps. (ii) Sustainable development is development that meets the needs of the present without compromising the ability of future generations to meet their own needs.
questions.chapter: Human Capital Formation / Rural Development / Sustainable Development

questions.text:
दिए गए गद्य का ध्यानपूर्वक अध्ययन कीजिए व निम्नलिखित प्रश्नों के उत्तर दीजिए :
तीव्र गति से वृद्धिमान जनसंख्या के प्रति-उत्तर में, चीन ने 'एकल संतान नीति' प्रारंभ की थी... (गद्य संक्षेप)
(क) चीन में एकल संतान नीति के कार्यान्वयन के परिणामों को समझाइए ।
(ख) चीन में एकल संतान नीति के कार्यान्वयन के किसी एक कारण का उल्लेख कीजिए।
questions.text_english:
Read the given text carefully and answer the following questions :
In response to the problem of rapidly rising population, China introduced the 'One Child Policy'... (passage summarized)
(a) Explain the consequences of implementation of the One Child Policy in China.
(b) State any one reason for the implementation of the One Child Policy in China.

key_points: Consequences: Aging population, gender imbalance, social challenges for single children.
Reason: Controlling rapidly rising population growth.

questions.solution: (a) The implementation of the One Child Policy had several demographic and social consequences for China. It resulted in an aging population due to lower birth rates, caused significant gender imbalances because of a traditional preference for male children, and created new social pressures for the single children generation. (b) The primary reason for implementing the policy was the need for the Chinese government to urgently control the rapidly rising population growth in the country.

मान्य तर्कों द्वारा, उल्लेख व विस्तृत व्याख्या कीजिए कि निम्नलिखित कथन सत्य हैं या असत्य :
(क) भारतीय ग्रामीण परिदृश्य में, कृषि विविधीकरण कृषकों की कई समस्याओं के समाधान के रूप में उभरा है।
(ख) भारत में कार्यबल के अनौपचारीकरण ने देश के युवाओं के मध्य रोज़गार सृजन के मोर्चे पर विभिन्न चिंताओं में वृद्धि की है।
questions.text_english:
State and elaborate whether the following statements are true/false, with valid arguments:
(a) In the Indian rural landscape, agricultural diversification has emerged as a solution for a lot of farmers' problems.
(b) Informalisation of workforce in India, has increased various concerns on the front of employment generation among the youth of the country.

key_points: True: Diversification helps increase income and reduces risk from crop failure.
True: Informal jobs lack security, benefits, and stability.

questions.solution: (a) This statement is true. Agricultural diversification allows farmers to shift from low-value, risky crops to a variety of high-value crops and non-farm activities like livestock and poultry. This strategy stabilizes income and mitigates the financial risks associated with dependency on a single seasonal crop. (b) This statement is true. The informalisation of the workforce means that many workers, including youth, are engaged in insecure jobs without legal protection, social security benefits, or stable wages. This creates long-term anxiety and uncertainty regarding the quality and sustainability of future employment.

questions.text:
(क) (i) आर्थिक सुधारों के दौरान भारत सरकार द्वारा किए गए कर सुधारों के कारणों व परिणामों पर संक्षेप में चर्चा कीजिए।
(ii) बहुपक्षीय व्यापार व द्वि-पक्षीय व्यापार में अंतर स्पष्ट कीजिए।
अथवा
(ख) (i) "आयात प्रतिस्थापन नीति, यदि सावधानी से लागू नहीं की जाए, तो किसी भी अर्थव्यवस्था के लिए दुधारी तलवार साबित हो सकती है।" क्या आप दिए गए कथन से सहमत हैं? मान्य तर्कों द्वारा अपने उत्तर की पुष्टि कीजिए।

questions.text_english:
(a) (i) Discuss briefly the causes and consequences of tax reforms undertaken by the Government of India during economic reforms.
(ii) Distinguish between multilateral trade and bilateral trade.
OR
(b) (i) "Import substitution policy, if not applied carefully, can prove to be a double-edged sword for any economy." Do you agree with the given statement? Justify your answer with valid arguments.
(ii) Distinguish between stabilisation measures and structural measures undertaken by the Government of India in 1991.

sub_questions.text: कर सुधार के कारण ঔर परिणাম।
sub_questions.text_english: Causes and consequences of tax reforms.
sub_questions.solution: Causes included simplifying complex tax structures and widening the tax base to increase government revenue. Consequences led to lower tax rates, improved compliance, and a more transparent fiscal environment.
Bilateral trade occurs between two countries. Multilateral trade involves more than two countries, often organized through bodies like the WTO.

Agree. Import substitution protects infant industries but can create inefficiencies and lack of competition, making domestic goods costly and inferior to global standards if kept protected for too long.
Stabilizing measures are short-term, meant to correct balance of payments and inflation. Structural measures are long-term, designed to improve the efficiency and competitiveness of the economy.

questions.solution: Tax reforms aimed at transparency and efficiency. Trade differences focus on participation. Import substitution acts as a double-edged sword by balancing domestic industry protection with the risk of market isolation. Stabilizing and structural measures differentiate short-term fixes from long-term systemic change.

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित गद्य का ध्यानपूर्वक अध्ययन कीजिए :
(1) आवधिक श्रम बल सर्वेक्षण के आँकड़ों के अनुसार, विगत छः वर्षों में, भारतीय श्रम बाज़ार संकेतकों में सुधार हुआ है। 2022 - 23 में बेरोज़गारी दर घट कर 3.2% हो गई है। कार्यबल में युवाओं व महिलाओं की भागीदारी में वृद्धि से जनसांख्यिकीय व लैंगिक लाभांश का लाभ उठाने के अवसर प्राप्त हुए हैं। फैक्ट्री रोज़गार आँकड़े वित्तीय वर्ष 2022 - 23 में संगठित विनिर्माण क्षेत्र में उछाल को दर्शाते हैं इसके साथ ही रोज़गार में वृद्धि व कारखानों का विस्तार सम्मिलित है।
(2) विगत पाँच वर्षों में EPFO के अंतर्गत शुद्ध वेतन प्राप्त करने वाले दोगुने से अधिक हो गए हैं, जो कि स्वस्थ विकास व औपचारिक रोज़गार का संकेत है।
(3) गुणवत्तापूर्ण रोज़गार सृजन करने व उसे बनाए रखने के लिए कृषि-प्रसंस्करण व देखभाल अर्थव्यवस्था के दो आशाजनक विकल्प हैं।
questions.text_english:
Read the following text carefully :
(1) Indian labour market indicators have improved in the last six years, as per the Periodic Labour Force Survey Data. The unemployment rate has fallen to 3.2% in 2022-23. Rising youth and female participation in the workforce present an opportunity to tap the demographic and gender dividend. The factory employment data exhibits the bounce back of the organised manufacturing sector in FY 2022-23 with rise in employment and the upscaling of factories.
(2) The net payroll additions under EPFO have more than doubled in the past five years, signalling healthy growth in formal employment.
(3) To generate and sustain quality employment, agro-processing and care economy are two promising candidates.

sub_questions.text: भारतीय कार्यबल में बढ़ती हुई युवा व महिला भागीदारी का कोई एक महत्त्व बताइए ।
sub_questions.text_english: State any one significance of rising youth and female participation in the Indian workforce.
sub_questions.solution: It allows the country to tap into the demographic and gender dividend, which accelerates economic growth and productivity.

sub_questions.text: भारत में गुणवत्तापूर्ण रोज़गार सृजन हेतु आशाजनक माने जाने वाले किन्हीं दो क्षेत्रों की पहचान कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Identify any two sectors which may be highlighted as promising for generating quality employment in India.
sub_questions.solution: The two sectors highlighted in the passage are agro-processing and the care economy.

sub_questions.text: उपयुक्त उदाहरण की सहायता से प्रच्छन्न बेरोज़गारी के अर्थ की विस्तृत व्याख्या कीजिए ।
sub_questions.text_english: Elaborate the meaning of disguised unemployment with the help of a suitable example.
sub_questions.solution: Disguised unemployment is a situation where more people are engaged in a job than actually required. If they were removed, the total output would remain unchanged. For example, if a small farm requires only two people to cultivate, but five family members are working on it, the three extra individuals are disguisedly unemployed.

questions.solution: The passage highlights improvements in the labor market through lower unemployment, rising formalization (EPFO data), and promising sectors for employment. Disguised unemployment refers to redundant labor in a work setting where productivity is unaffected by their presence.
